Thanks for the clear asks. Proposed responses below (attached redline v3):

1) SLA credit calc: We can specify that SLA credit calculations for the 30-day bridging period will apply only to traffic routed to Redwood production endpoints (we will exclude test/split traffic documented in the migration plan). We'll include an explicit definition of "post-migration traffic" and the tracing tags required for attribution.

3) Billing cadence: Our standard renewals billing is monthly in arrears. As a one-off courtesy for Landmark we can accept invoice Net-30 for the first two billing cycles post-commencement provided the PO is issued prior to go-live. We'll add language for an early-payment rebate if Landmark pays within 15 days (1.5% rebate).

Attached: redlines-msa-addendum-v3.pdf (highlights on sections 2, 4, 7)
